title: CCA sweep · concept overview
subtitle: Three axes, one shared research view
description: A simplified reading of the Mitchell Institute sweep concept. Explore how abstract CCA groups and a crewed element relate across presentation phases.
assumptions: All geography, timings, paths and actor counts are editorial illustration, not taken from the source.
Timeline seconds control the presentation only; they do not represent flight time, speed, range or readiness.
Lines indicate conceptual relationships, not verified interfaces or actual connectivity.
No engagement outcomes, targeting, tactics optimization or capability predictions are computed.

phases.title: Introduce
phases.narrative: Identify the three abstract CCA groups and the crewed element.

phases.title: Explore relationships
phases.narrative: The published concept combines crewed fighters with CCA on one axis. The displayed links are explanatory.

phases.title: Review
phases.narrative: Revisit the concept and inspect provenance. No mission outcome is calculated.
